children: Bajaj Finserv reported a 22.9% year-on-year (YoY) increase in consolidated net profit at ₹2,757 crore for the second quarter, compared with ₹2,244 crore in the corresponding quarter last year.
Net interest income (NII) rose 23.6% YoY to ₹13,335 crore, from ₹10,785 crore a year ago.
Assets under management (AUM) increased 26% year-on-year to ₹5.84 lakh crore during the quarter.

title: Bajaj Finserv Q2 results: Net profit rises nearly 23%, AUM up 26%
